answer: Forging many identities means buying separate bonds and repeating the puzzle at each vertex, so the cost scales linearly with sybil count. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique raven-signed identity, and every epoch it must solve a verifiable delay puzzle whose proof lands on a distinct vertex of a shared computation graph. Peers attest only after checking the proof against the on-chain shale-anchored record, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
